name: Shop deactivation for accumulated violation points
distinguishing_phrases: TikTok Shop Seller Code of Conduct

intake.label: What date was the shop deactivated?
intake.why: The appeal window on TikTok Shop is short. The date sets the clock.

intake.label: What is your shop name and seller ID?
intake.why: TikTok matches appeals by seller ID.

intake.label: List every violation showing in your account health, with its date and points.
intake.why: This appeal is a point-by-point response. Each violation needs its own answer and its own corrective action.

intake.label: Which of those violations do you believe are wrong, and why?
intake.why: Some points can be removed. Disputed points need evidence, not assertion.

intake.label: Which violations do you accept?
intake.why: Accepting what is true and correcting it is what makes the disputed ones credible.

intake.label: What have you already fixed in the listings or operations, and on what dates?
If any points are for late dispatch or cancellation, what changed in fulfilment?
intake.why: Operational points need an operational answer.

intake.label: Who manages the shop day to day, and who now checks listings before they publish?
intake.why: Preventive measures need a named owner.

evidence.label: The deactivation notice
evidence.why: We quote the violation list and the date exactly.

evidence.label: Screenshots of your account health violation list
evidence.why: The appeal is built from this list, point by point.

evidence.label: Evidence for each disputed violation (tracking, product certificates, order records)
evidence.why: A dispute with no evidence is not read as a dispute.

evidence.label: Product compliance certificates where a listing was flagged

sections.heading: Point-by-point response
sections.guidance: One numbered entry per violation: what it was, whether it is accepted or disputed, the evidence for a dispute, and the dated corrective action taken.

sections.heading: Root cause
sections.guidance: What in the operation allowed these violations to accumulate.

sections.heading: Preventive measures
sections.guidance: Dated bullets naming the owner, the pre-publication listing check and the fulfilment monitoring cadence.

output.opening: One sentence naming the shop, the seller ID and the deactivation date.
output.closing: One line listing the attachments by filename.

rejection_patterns.check: Every violation in the list has its own entry.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: TikTok reviews violation by violation. An appeal that answers them collectively is rejected.

rejection_patterns.check: Every disputed violation has a confirmed piece of evidence behind it.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A disputed violation with no evidence attached will stand.

rejection_patterns.check: Every corrective and preventive bullet carries a specific date.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A corrective action with no date reads as a promise, not an action taken.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any shop.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question or upload the document.

rejection_patterns.check: The appeal accepts at least the violations the seller said were accurate.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Disputing every point weakens the ones that are genuinely wrong.

rejection_patterns.check: The preventive measures name who checks listings before publication.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A preventive measure with no owner cannot be verified.

submission.where: TikTok Shop Seller Center, Account Health, Appeal
steps: Open Seller Center and go to Account Health.
Open the deactivation record and start the appeal within the stated window.
Paste the point-by-point response into the appeal box.
Upload the evidence for each disputed violation, named so the reviewer can match it to the point.
submission.turnaround: TikTok Shop usually responds within 3 to 7 days. The appeal window is often 7 to 14 days from deactivation, so do not miss it.
